working: Alumni eNews - July 2026 (7/9) remains the best recent send: 57.3% open and +77.2% session lift (14.5 -> 25.7 daily sessions), and the 7/16 reminder still hit 46.8% open with +1.5% lift.
Program-wide open rates are excellent: 51.6% average across 100 campaigns, well above the 25-35% health/nonprofit benchmark.
Referring Partners eNews earns the best engagement per opener: 3.82% click-to-open in July and 4.35% in June, despite modest ~27% opens on a small (~955) list.
The historic playbook is clear: client-facing seasonal/event sends drive the biggest spikes (Client eNews - August +1263% lift at 50.7% open; Client eNews - January 2025 +444.6%).
SEO footprint keeps inching up vs the 8/6 run: pages with impressions 92 -> 96 and impressions 3,293 -> 3,338 in the GSC window.
not_working: UTM leakage persists: the 7/20 sends produced 2 Email vs 21 Direct sessions in 3 days, and the 7/9 Alumni send 4 vs 33. Email shows only 16 sessions (0.1%) across the whole window while Direct is 50.6% - newsletter links are missing UTM tags, so GA4 mis-credits Email as Direct.
Staff-Client eNews underperforms at scale: the 7/20 send to 8,906 contacts got 0.43% clicks and -27.3% lift; the 7/2 send was -25.3%. Biggest list, weakest results two sends running.
Constant Contact live fetch is broken: token refresh returns 401 invalid_client, so campaign data is cached through 7/20 and no newer sends are visible.
Organic Social contributes only 5.4% of sessions (1,725) over the window.
GSC clicks are flat run-over-run (42 -> 41) at an impression-weighted position of 14.3 - visibility is growing but not yet converting to page-one clicks.
do_next: Add utm_source=constantcontact&utm_medium=email to every newsletter link - the single biggest measurement fix; it will reclassify the ~20-35 post-send Direct sessions per send as Email.
Re-authorize the Constant Contact API credential (401 invalid_client on token refresh; see CONSTANT-CONTACT-SETUP.md) so sends after 7/20 flow into the dashboard.
Repromote alumni/event-style content: the Alumni eNews formula (+77.2% lift, 57.3% open on 7/9) and seasonal client eNews themes (August +1263%, January +444.6%) are the proven lift drivers.
Rework the Staff-Client eNews before the August send: one strong CTA and a subject-line test - 0.43-0.81% clicks on an ~8,900 list is the largest untapped audience in the program.
SEO follow-up: push internal links toward tracked keywords sitting near position 14 to convert the growing impressions (3,338) into clicks, which have been flat at ~41.
summary: Traffic mix is steady (31,953 sessions in window; Direct 50.6%, Organic Search 33.6%) and opens stay strong at 51.6% avg, but July's big Staff-Client sends lost ground (-27.3% lift) while the Alumni send gained +77.2%. Top fixes: add UTM tags to newsletter links and re-authorize the Constant Contact API (data cached since 7/20, token refresh now failing).
